title: About Us
metaDescription: Who we are, how TopProductPick is funded and why we never claim tests we didn't run.
lede: TopProductPick is a small independent research site that helps people choose everyday products they won't want to return, across home, tech, health and outdoor gear.

p: We read manufacturer specs and manuals, cross-check independent reviews and owner reports, and turn that into clear recommendations for specific kinds of buyers.
We don't claim our own lab testing, invent ratings, or publish prices that will be out of date tomorrow. When we're unsure, we say so.
We earn a commission when readers buy through some of our links, including as an Amazon Associate. That never decides which products we recommend. See our affiliate disclosure for details.
